en: The postcard image depicts a public square or open area in front of a building with a red roof and simple, functional architecture. There are several people, including children, sitting and standing around. There are numerous green trees, hedges, and a large amphora-style jar or vase as part of the square's decor. The scene is sunlit and appears tranquil, likely during the summer. The back of the postcard contains text in Bulgarian, German, and French, identifying the place as the cultural center (Chitalishte) of the village of Byala in the Varna region of Bulgaria.
